before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: I say! Where on Gielinor did that voice come from?

before-grim-tales.player: Uh...hello there! Can you hear me?

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: Why yes. Yes I can. My word. Is that...is that one of the gods? Guthix perhaps? Saradomin?

before-grim-tales.player: No, no. I'm not either of them.

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: Egad! You're not...Zamorak...are you? I mean, uh...begging your pardon of course, my Lord. No offence intended!

before-grim-tales.player: Ha ha! No, I'm speaking to you through the pipe here! I'm at the bottom of your tower.

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: Oh. Oh I see! Oh, yes. How clever! Remarkable idea! How ever did you think of that? Good show, old bean!

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: Rupert the Beard. At your service, old fruit.

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: Yes, old turnip. On account of my wonderfully long bearded chin, you see.

before-grim-tales.player: So what are you doing up there exactly? And how come you talk so strangely?

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: What am I doing? Well, I guess I'm stuck in a matter of speaking. Dear me, yes! I'm stuck. And I speak in the King's speech, I'll have you know.

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: Which K...? Why, THE King old spud! THE King! Only one worth mentioning in my opinion.

before-grim-tales.player: Hey, you're not related to Sir Tiffy by any chance are you?

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: What? That namby pamby nincompoop? Not on your nelly! More fluff in the ears than sense, that man!

before-grim-tales.player: I see. Well is there anything I can do to help you up there?

before-grim-tales.speaker: Drain pipe
before-grim-tales.text: Hmmm. No, no, I can't think of anything at the moment. I'm a bit stuck. Let me know if you get any ideas though.

after-grim-tales.npc: Hello again, old cheesecake! Wonderful to see you.

steps.npc: Thanks to you freeing me, very well! I have much more to do of course, but now I am free, I can continue where I left off.

options.text: Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?

steps.player: Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?

steps.npc: You might be in luck, old bellybutton fluff - I have made replacements. You could have one for 60,000 coins - for the materials, you understand.

steps.text: If the player has less than 60,000 coins:

steps.player: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.

steps.npc: No problem! Come back and see me any time, old garters.

options.text: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
